style: Classic warm flat vector illustration in bottle green (#183028), mustard (#e6b85c) and cream, calm solid shapes, gentle grain, no text.

subjects.mecanique-generale: An open car engine bay seen from above with a plain smooth engine cover (no emblem, no badge); a hand-held diagnostic scanner lies on the fender, plugged in by its cable, a combination wrench beside it. No hands, no people.

hero: A tidy neighbourhood repair garage interior: a car on a lift, a mustard tool chest, a workbench with a service logbook and neatly hung tools, warm lamps. All cars are generic invented designs: no recognizable real models, no brand grilles, no badges or emblems. Flat vector, DARK bottle green overall, mustard highlights, cream accents. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people, no numbers.
